title: Map current code and relevant audit prerequisites
implementation_scope: Inspect actual HEAD and update feature map; retain existing features; identify only prerequisites needed by this project.
acceptance: Baseline commit recorded; ownership/reward/lifecycle blockers mapped; texture hashes saved.

title: Record interaction and crowded-board baselines
implementation_scope: Five representative action tasks; deterministic four-seat fixture; performance and human observation forms.
acceptance: Gesture counts and measured results recorded, or explicitly unmeasured; environment documented.

title: Create shared action descriptions and dispatch bindings
implementation_scope: Start with six tutorial verbs and existing handlers; supply menus/help/palette through one catalogue.
acceptance: No duplicate authority path; target availability and labels agree across entry points.

title: Expose rebindable shortcuts and contextual help
implementation_scope: Loader key registration, common dispatcher, text-focus precedence and current-binding labels.
acceptance: Rebinding updates prompts; chat/search typing cannot trigger gameplay actions; both loaders tested.

title: Extend versioned client preferences
implementation_scope: Scales, motion, sounds, tutorial and bounded favorites; preserve theme and old config.
acceptance: Restart/migration/malformed-file tests pass; no disk write per render or slider tick.

title: Add exact operation feedback and reconciliation contract
implementation_scope: Pending/confirmed/failed/unknown states keyed to operation and session; reuse corrected network paths.
acceptance: Mismatched/untagged results cannot finish another operation; timeout cannot duplicate a mutation.
status: Done - both waiting screens mint, resolve and render through it; the overdue state is what they lacked

title: Replace the server practice session with a local demonstration
implementation_scope: Local in-memory board built on the pure core fold; no server session, seat, block or saved flag. Retire the old practice path and migrate saves that hold one.
acceptance: No packet leaves the client for any tutorial action; owned property cannot reach the board because the board cannot hold any; legacy practice saves clean up idempotently.
status: In progress - overlay implemented and isolated; retirement and save migration not started

title: Implement six-step optional tutorial on the local board
implementation_scope: Pure state machine plus small overlay; local sample-state transitions and local inspect evidence; skip/review/restart, restart after exhaustion.
acceptance: All six steps work with remapped controls and alternate gestures; refused actions do not advance; restart works after the sample library is empty.
status: Implemented on the local board - 8 in-world tests; remapped controls and graphical behavior unverified

title: Validate first-game usability
implementation_scope: Script real controls and run newcomer walkthrough; offline/warm-cache and slow-service cases.
acceptance: External instructions unnecessary in observed session; missing human/cache evidence disclosed.
status: Not started for the replacement - the scripted client has not been run since the overlay landed

title: Add contextual searchable action palette
implementation_scope: Translated names/aliases, target summary, keyboard navigation and discoverable menu entry.
acceptance: Same action behavior as menus; text focus safe; no hidden card data in search.

title: Unify selection and bounded bulk action behavior
implementation_scope: Selection policy, target summaries, ordinary server validation, aggregate feedback.
acceptance: Stale/replaced/hidden targets do not broaden operation; batch size bounded; partial failures visible.

title: Add bounded recent and favorite counters/tokens
implementation_scope: Extend existing counter shortcuts; store safe names/printing references; server-specific scoping.
acceptance: Restart persistence, missing token, custom-ID scope and server switching tested; no retained instance IDs.
status: Done - pinned favorites added; remembered counter names are finally offered (they were written to disk and read by nobody); 5 in-world tests

title: Compare frequent-action workflows against baseline
implementation_scope: Repeat five tasks and revise the controls that add friction.
acceptance: Before/after gesture/time observations reported; improvements not inferred from feature count.

title: Improve ownership/counter readability and scalable layout
implementation_scope: Owner/controller labels, non-color cues, independent text/control scales, shared render/pick geometry.
acceptance: Small windows, large settings, translations and both board views remain usable.
status: Done - owner badges where control and ownership differ, a non-color SeatMark beside every seat's colour, and independent text/control scales that now actually work; render and pick geometry were already shared

title: Add accessible overlap and pile inspection
implementation_scope: Local chooser/fan view for authorized visible cards; keyboard and pointer selection.
acceptance: Bottom visible card reachable; no silent moves or hidden-identity disclosure.
status: Done - a chooser lists every card this player may read under the cursor, reachable by menu, palette search or a bound key; a face-down card carries no id by design and so cannot be singled out

title: Add explicit arrange-selection preview and apply
implementation_scope: Deterministic core layout using current positions and attachment groups; cancelable local preview.
acceptance: Server revalidates on apply; identities/count/rotation/attachments preserved; cannot silently reorder others.
status: Done - ArrangeSelection plans in core (12 unit tests); the plan is previewed as outlines, Enter applies it as ordinary per-card moves the server revalidates, Escape drops it

title: Run crowded-board interaction checks
implementation_scope: Four-seat fixtures and near-limit workload with screenshots plus actual picking/actions.
acceptance: Labels/selection inspectable; geometry agrees; frame-time comparison and limits documented.

title: Define progression milestones and opt-in server profiles
implementation_scope: Reuse current settings; profiles for casual collection, long-running collection and imported play.
acceptance: Profile diff/apply/restore behavior documented; existing world defaults and inventories preserved.

title: Add target-deck collection guidance
implementation_scope: Reuse want lists and builder counts; owned/missing/spare counts and truthful configured acquisition hints.
acceptance: Printing vs card identity explicit; sources unknown/disabled handled; private inventories/loot never exposed.

title: Playtest and tune collection journey
implementation_scope: Fresh-player and established-player manual/local metrics; optional starter/precon routes; no new salvage currency.
acceptance: First-game and first-owned-deck outcomes distinguished; observed rates or unmeasured status published.

title: Specify minimal common reward data contract
implementation_scope: Extend sealed-product entry/shared product definitions; bounded fields, server precedence and reload policy.
acceptance: Schema validated against actual 1.21.1 codecs; no arbitrary code/URLs; errors identify resource and field.

title: Implement safe reward loading and loader adapters
implementation_scope: Atomic definition snapshots; optional mod conditions; cache-ready loot/recipe behavior and grant identity.
acceptance: Absent dependencies load; invalid reload preserves prior valid snapshot; no blocking HTTP or duplicate grants.

title: Ship verified optional Cataclysm reward example
implementation_scope: Separate additive example pack against verified installed encounter/loot IDs.
acceptance: Exact version/IDs documented; one intended award path; repeatability, disable and reload tested.

title: Ship verified optional Create production example
implementation_scope: Separate example recipe pack or minimal adapter; bounded costs and correct output components.
acceptance: Automation/partial/full-output/repeat tests pass; no consumed-input empty result; no accidental resource loop.

title: Publish pack-author integration guide and compatibility matrix
implementation_scope: Working examples, schema limits, reload policy, exact loader/mod versions and absent-mod cases.
acceptance: Generic Fabric/NeoForge support distinguished from loader-specific examples; Aeronautics separately tested or unverified.

title: Refine existing sounds and event aggregation
implementation_scope: Local volume/mute/preview, cue map, deduplication and quiet positional behavior using existing sounds.
acceptance: Batch/snapshot/replay/neighbor-table cases do not spam; hidden information not encoded into sound.
status: Partial - the sound toggle and volume are real now (both were dead); no sound refinement or event aggregation yet

title: Complete motion, inspection and keyboard accessibility
implementation_scope: Reduced flights/tilt/transitions, effect intensity, hold-toggle inspect, focus/narration and consistent Escape.
acceptance: Tutorial and frequent tasks complete keyboard-only, muted and reduced-motion; no texture edits.
status: Partial - reduced motion, hold-or-press to inspect, effect intensity and the turn notification are real now (all four were dead); narration and full keyboard access not started

title: Run integrated release acceptance and handoff
implementation_scope: Current verify/static gates; actual clients; four-human session; copied-save/config upgrade; texture hash check.
acceptance: Six-feature acceptance matrix with evidence; automated/human/modpack results distinct; remaining limits candid.
